# Source template: common/scripted_effects/bca_job_regulation_gear_apply.txt.j2


# 增加方向


bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = $LIMIT$ value <= $TARGET$ } }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g3200
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g800
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g200
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g50
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = value:bca_jr_min_value|LEFT|4250|RIGHT|$LIMIT$|
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = $TARGET$ value >= 3200 } }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g3200
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value = 3200 }
            subtract_variable = { which = $TARGET$ value = 3200 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = $TARGET$ value >= 800 } }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g800
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value = 800 }
            subtract_variable = { which = $TARGET$ value = 800 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable_arithmetic = { which = $TARGET$ value >= 200 } }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g200
            add_variable = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value = 200 }
            subtract_variable = { which = $TARGET$ value = 200 }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g50
        add_variable = { which = bca_jr_actual_job_change value = 50 }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = value:bca_jr_min_value|LEFT|bca_jr_actual_job_change|RIGHT|$LIMIT$|
        }
    }
}
